kind: rigorous extension of the model-cost interface
statement: Finite-defect resolvent rank supplies a fixed relative-count range of length≤d even without semiboundedness, yielding the same3d three-height cost for genuine unbounded boundary extensions.
compatible_assumptions: Closed densely defined common symmetric restriction; equal finite deficiency(d,d); same full Hilbert space; fixed selfadjoint domains; one compact resolvent. SourceTheorem1.1's lower-bound hypothesis is preserved in its record and is replaced here by an independent two-branch resolvent proof.
new_claim_suggested: An actual finite-defect realization of an energy-dependent boundary scattering formula cannot evade the reference counting-curvature cost solely through unbounded boundary evaluation.
already_proved: Resolvent rank≤d via ker(S*−i), exact transport to a real anchor, compact-tail inertia bounds, identical relative-count range on positive/negative reciprocal branches, sharp3d example.
conjectural: No claim that an arbitrary unitary S(k) is realizable by such an operator; verifying the full-domain realization is a separate task.
next_step: For a concrete proposed boundary/auxiliary system write its full domain, common S, deficiency indices and compactness proof, then insert the actual effective rankr≤d into the cost bound.
potential_counterexamples: Infinite deficiency, essential spectrum through the counted window, an energy-dependent domain without fixed selfadjoint realization, or comparisons on different Hilbert spaces without a full-space reference fall outside the theorem.
tests: Exact first-order quasiperiodic extension with θ1=3/20,θ0=2/5,K=3/10 saturates3; both reciprocal branches and eigenvalue endpoints checked by experiments/code/extension_interlacing_round2.py.
significance: Closes the specific bounded-coupling-to-unbounded-boundary gap for a precise realizable class; distinguishes range-lengthd from a loose2d estimate.
difficulty: Auxiliary proof elementary operator theory; modeling and sharp defect accounting for singular energy-dependent interactions can be substantial.
status: Complete auxiliary proof with independent parent review; no literature novelty claim or full source-paper audit.
